sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Balloon is a simple yet challenging game that requires players to pop as many balloons as possible within a 30-second time limit. The game starts with a single row of balloons, and as you progress, new rows are added, making it increasingly difficult to pop all the balloons on time. The gameplay is divided into two main modes: normal mode and expert mode. In normal mode, players have the standard 30 seconds to pop the balloons, while in expert mode, the time limit is reduced to 15 seconds.

The controls are easy to use and can be accessed using a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it accessible to players across various platforms. The game also features a variety of sound effects, including the sound of the balloon popping, which adds to the overall immersive experience. The graphics are colorful and vibrant, with each balloon having a unique design, making the game visually appealing.

One of the unique features of Balloon is its increasing difficulty level. As you progress through the game, the balloons start to move faster, and new obstacles are introduced, such as obstacles that block the path to the balloons. This makes it challenging for players to pop all the balloons on time, requiring them to stay focused and react quickly to the changing environment.
